sources.quote: Priced at just $0.25/1M input tokens and $1.50/1M output tokens, 3.1 Flash-Lite delivers enhanced performance at a fraction of the cost of larger models.
sources.supports: Google's launch announcement establishes the official input and output rates for Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite preview.

notes: Google's March 3, 2026 launch announcement priced the preview at $0.25 input and $1.50 output per million tokens, so models.dev's earlier $0.50/$3.00 base rates were not the provider's official rates. The announcement does not state cache-read pricing or when models.dev corrected its record; no effective date for a provider price change applies.
